title: Unit 9 Consolidation: Conditionals I & Potential Scenarios
goal: Consolidate hypothetical conditionals, polite mitigations, strict prerequisites, and analyze Isabel Allende's 'Dos palabras'.
grammar: síntesis de oraciones condicionales potenciales, cortesía y requisitos estrictos

items: Deploy the second conditional (si + imperfecto subjuntivo + condicional simple) effortlessly across speech and writing.
Utilize stylistic variants in the apodosis (quisiera, debiera, pudiera) in high-register prose.
Formulate strict contractual conditions with 'siempre que', 'con tal de que', and 'a condición de que'.
Set definitive negative exceptions with 'a menos que' and 'salvo que'.
Analyze the emancipatory power of words and persuasion in Isabel Allende's masterpiece.
I can form potential conditionals using 'si' with the imperfect subjunctive and conditional.
I can use 'quisiera' and 'debiera' to soften statements and requests politely.
I can state mandatory conditions using 'siempre que' with the subjunctive.
I can express exceptions using 'a menos que' with the subjunctive.
